prior_importants.description: A branch that only deletes a real binary of a format outside BINARY_FORMATS (a .pdf, .gif, .woff2, .webp, .zip), or a PNG/JPEG over 1 MiB, now recounts its newline bytes as deleted source lines and names the file in `forged`. Before this PR it answered null. Nothing reaches the tree, so this is a false forged flag, and the bogus count can also trip the oversize flag.

A `.gitattributes` `working-tree-encoding` attribute rewrites a known-binary blob on checkout, so a blob that passes the ICO/TIFF/MKV/TTF magic and zip/phar/tar refusals is checked out as a real zip or phar, carrying uncounted compressed source past the diff-size gate.

A gitlink (160000) side is read as a blob. If a branch swaps a binary file for a submodule at the same path, or a submodule for a binary file, `cat-file -s` or `git diff <blob> <commit>` throws, and the merge gate errors on every re-gate. Before this change the old code skipped that entry.

The known-binary tar check reads the raw blob, but a branch .gitattributes `text eol=crlf` or `ident` on the path rewrites its first 512 bytes at checkout, so a PNG that passes the check lands as a PHP tar phar whose uncounted entry runs.

process_issues.description: Round 7 used the importants-only budget, so conventions, docs, context, simplicity and maintainability were skipped. Spec was skipped because the PR closes no issue and gives no --spec source. Workflow-safety was skipped because the PR's diff changes no workflow file (main's merge touched pr-status.yml, but that file is outside the PR diff). The diff is about 1,850 lines, so correctness and security each ran two instances. The head since the prior record (9af5010 -> 0139f4c) is a clean merge from main with no conflict hunks in the PR's files. git-diff.client.ts and known-binary.utils.ts are unchanged, so the four prior importants are still unresolved. Reviewers mentioned two stale-prose notes that fall below the round-7 bar, and neither was recorded: ADR 0154 around line 172 still says ls-tree where the code runs cat-file -s, and the filesNaming JSDoc was already raised in an earlier round. The guards reviewer did not read scripts/adr-index.sh or ADR 0154's body. It only checked that ADR number 0154 is not already taken.
